title: Car Sensor Deewar Dekhta Nahi, Sunta Hai 🔊 #shorts
description:
Car ka parking sensor deewar ko dekhta nahi, phir bhi bilkul sahi waqt par beep karta hai. Kaise? Awaaz ke echo se!
🔊 HC-SR04 ke andar piezo disc 40 kHz par kaampta hai
📡 8 pulse jaate hain aur deewar se echo wapas aata hai
🧮 Distance = time x 343 / 2, yaani cm = microseconds / 58
🔌 Arduino wiring ki ek galti jo aapka reading bigaad degi
Aur 3D explainers ke liye subscribe karo.
#shorts #ultrasonic #hc-sr04 #arduino #parkingsensor #hindi #electronics

Yeh dekh nahi sakta, phir bhi rukta hai 🔊
Car ka parking sensor deewar ko kaise pehchanta hai? Jawab hai awaaz ka echo, aur aap isse apna robot bhi bana sakte ho 👇
🔊 HC-SR04 40 kHz ki awaaz bhejta hai, jo hamen sunai nahi deti
⏱️ Echo ka time naap kar distance nikalta hai: cm = microseconds / 58
🧽 Soft kapda aur tirchi surface echo ko kamzor kar dete hain
🔌 VCC 5V par lagao, 3.3V par reading galat aayegi
💾 Save karo, jab Arduino par sensor lagao
📤 Us dost ko bhejo jo robot banana chahta hai
